title: PPI Leads to a Not-So-Dull Tape
summary: Investors need to be thankful for revisions. This morning’s July PPI report proved to be the catalyst that yesterday’s CPI was not. Stocks and bonds both reacted quite positively after the better-than-expected inflation figures. A quick glance at the headlines certainly showed another set of disinflationary statistics, but a detailed view of the statistics made them less exciting than they first appeared. That hasn’t dampened the enthusiasm, though.
